title: Multicentric study to evaluate potential vessel damage in patients suffering from Thalidomide brth defect (Contergan)
summary: Aim of the study is a comparison of vessels from patients suffering from birth anomalie due to Contergan with healthy control.
conditions: Other congenital malformations of peripheral vascular system

interventions.name: MRI in patients with birth defect caused by Thalidomid

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
patients, registered by Contergan foundation with an underlying malfunction or disability caused by Thalidomide; healthy volunteers
Exclusion criteria:
known contraindication for assessment by MRI; pregnancy; Body weight higher than 150 kg; Claustrophobia
